label: ThinkPad X1 Carbon Gen 11
description: 1.12 kg 14-inch carbon-fibre ultrabook, 13th-gen Core U/P, two Thunderbolt 4 and Wi-Fi 6E; no RJ45.
notes: No onboard Ethernet - Lenovo expects a USB-C/USB-A Ethernet dongle or dock (1GbE). Wi-Fi 6E AX211 is the only native link, so this node's uplink is wireless unless a dongle is modelled.
